newsitem.title: CUBA: Haitian migrants repatriated from Cuba.
newsitem.headline: Haitian migrants repatriated from Cuba.

text.p: More than 280 Haitian men, women and children were flown back to Haiti from Cuba Wednesday in the latest repatriation of Haitian migrants jointly organised by the Cuban and Haitian Red Cross, Cuban state media said.

Their return brought to more than 900 the number of Haitian nationals repatriated from Cuba this year. Haitian migrants headed for the United States often arrive in eastern Cuba after their flimsy boats are either shipwrecked or blown off course.

The Haitians flown home Wednesday had been sheltering at a camp for Haitian boat people set up at Maisi, on the eastern tip of Cuba. They were believed to include some or all of a group of 279 Haitian boat people who landed in eastern Cuba in November.
